about: Two real redis scale-to-zero outages five minutes apart on the kind victim app (2026-10-17). Live, the first scored 0.81 and the repeat 0.38 inconclusive: two log_error lines from the first outage were never closed, so the repeat's scale-to-zero was taken for a repair of it (Remediation x0.35). Captured through the Chronicle API (/api/events, /api/graph).
